pattern_1.transformation: Assemble local timestamp from the split integer columns Year, Month, Day, Hour, then convert to ISO-8601 UTC. Local timezone assumed to be standard time UTC-7 (Etc/GMT+7) for these western-US Sierra sites; no package metadata was available to confirm the timezone.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Local time (UTC-7, no DST) to UTC.

pattern_1.transformation: Depth is embedded in the VWC column names (VWC-50cm, VWC-15cm, VWC-5cm). Reshaped wide-to-long and parsed the numeric depth from the column name.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 100 to convert from cm to m (0.50 m, 0.15 m, 0.05 m).

pattern_1.transformation: Direct mapping of the three VWC sensor columns. Values are already reported in m3/m3 (observed roughly 0.05-0.30); -9999 treated as missing. A handful of physically implausible values (>1 or <0) are retained unclipped, consistent with raw-sensor exemplar handling.

site_id assigned from the payload filename stem (Carbone_conifer, Carbone_aspen), as no site column is present in the files. Note: Carbone_aspen.csv has no header row; its 24 columns were assigned from the header of Carbone_conifer.csv, which has identical structure.

No location metadata file in the package, no cached ESS-DIVE metadata directory present, and no approved location registry in the workspace resolves these sites. Coordinates left as null; qc_flag = 'g2'.
